title: Feedback Coding Enables Inference-Time Covert Agentic Communication
abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate digital interactions, users can leverage LLM-generated text as cover for covert communication within seemingly benign conversations. Existing LLM steganography, however, is predominantly white-box, requiring the sender and receiver to share the cover statistics, typically through access to the model weights and prompt. Black-box schemes remove this requirement by allowing the receiver to operate solely on the generated text, but current approaches rely on fixed-length, open-loop watermarking techniques that suffer from high decoding error rates under variable-length token generation. We recast black-box LLM steganography as a sequential communication problem with causal, noiseless feedback: every generated token is observed by both parties and can guide subsequent embedding. Based on this perspective, we introduce \textbf{B}urnashev \textbf{A}daptive Posterior \textbf{M}atching (BAM), a feedback-coding scheme that combines posterior matching with a decode-and-confirm phase. The design is inspired by classical information-theoretic feedback-coding principles, while its security is established through a cryptographic reduction proof. Across three open-weight language models, we demonstrate that BAM attains 0-0.1\% empirical message error on an 8-bit payload in around 50 tokens, across 1000 trials, versus 10-17\% for the strongest black-box baseline at comparable length. Building on the proposed steganography algorithm, we demonstrate the feasibility of an end-to-end communication protocol that achieves high communication rates across multiple conversational settings.
title_cn: 反馈编码使能推理时的隐蔽智能体通信
abstract_cn: 随着 LLM 日益自动化数字交互，用户可把 LLM 生成文本当作掩护，在看似良性的对话中进行隐蔽通信。现有 LLM 隐写多为白盒：收发双方需共享掩护统计（通常需访问模型权重与提示）。黑盒方案去掉该要求、让接收方只依赖生成文本，但现有方法依赖定长开环水印，在变长 token 生成下解码错误率高。我们把黑盒 LLM 隐写重述为带因果无噪反馈的顺序通信问题：每个生成 token 都被双方观测并可用于引导后续嵌入。基于此视角，我们提出 Burnashev 自适应后向匹配（BAM）——结合后向匹配与解码-确认相的反馈编码方案，设计受经典信息论反馈编码启发，安全性由密码学归约证明保证。在三个开放权重模型上，BAM 在约 50 个 token 内以 0–0.1% 的经验消息错误率传输 8 位载荷（1,000 次试验），而同等长度的最强黑盒基线为 10–17%。基于该隐写算法，我们演示了跨多对话场景实现高通信速率的端到端协议。
summary_cn: 把黑盒 LLM 隐写重述为带反馈的顺序通信并给出 BAM 编码：约 50 token 传 8 bit 错误率 ≤0.1%（基线 10–17%），带安全性归约证明。
objective_summary: 以反馈编码重构黑盒 LLM 隐写并提出 BAM 方案，理论归约 + 多模型实验验证错误率与速率优势。
evidence_note: 密码学归约证明 + 三模型 1,000 次试验的量化对比；检测方（隐写分析）对抗未评估。
novelty_note: 把经典反馈编码（Burnashev）引入 LLM 隐写是干净的跨域迁移，解决变长解码错误的实际问题。
scope: 结论适用于自回归 LLM 文本生成与所测载荷规模；对强隐写分析对手未验证。
limitations: 隐蔽性评估限于分布层面；速率受确认相位开销限制；对采样温度敏感性未讨论。

title: Residual Community Prototypes Under-Reject Held-Out Malware Families in FCG-MFD
abstract: Open-set malware-family recognition must classify known families while rejecting families absent from training. We test whether Louvain-community summaries add rejection information beyond a graph neural network embedding and dimension-matched generic topology. The study uses a deduplicated, conflict-audited FCG-MFD corpus, five held-out families, and three optimization seeds. Community features are residualized against generic topology using known-family training data before nearest-prototype scoring. Residual community does not produce stable held-out-family rejection. Ranking effects reverse across families, the false-positive rate at 95 percent unknown recall worsens for every held-out family, and a validation-fitted threshold rejects only 4.48 percent of unknown samples. Accepted-known macro F1 improves in every family, but with five independent family units the exact two-sided sign-flip p-value is 0.0625, the smallest attainable value. The score remains associated with graph scale, while simple classifier uncertainty performs better on ranking, high-recall rejection, and OSCR. In this GIN/FCG-MFD setting, community-enriched prototypes change known-class geometry without creating a stable unknown margin. Graph open-set evaluations should pair structural features with matched topology controls, operational thresholds, and held-out-family analysis.
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables
title_cn: 残余社区原型在 FCG-MFD 留出家族上拒绝失效
abstract_cn: 开放集恶意软件家族识别要在分类已知家族的同时拒绝训练中缺席的家族。我们检验 Louvain 社区摘要是否在 GNN 嵌入与维度匹配的通用拓扑之外提供额外拒绝信息。研究使用去重、冲突审计的 FCG-MFD 语料、五个留出家族与三个优化种子：社区特征先用已知家族训练数据对通用拓扑做残差化，再最近原型打分。残余社区特征不能产生稳定的留出家族拒绝：排序效应跨家族反转、每个留出家族在 95% 未知召回下的 FPR 都恶化、验证集拟合的阈值只拒绝 4.48% 的未知样本。已接受已知类的宏 F1 在每个家族都提升，但五个独立家族单位下双侧符号翻转 p 值为 0.0625（可达最小值）。分数仍与图规模相关，而简单分类器不确定性在排序、高召回拒绝与 OSCR 上表现更好。在此 GIN/FCG-MFD 设定中，社区增强的原型改变了已知类几何却没有建立稳定的未知边际。图开放集评估应把结构特征与匹配拓扑对照、运维阈值与留出家族分析配对。
summary_cn: 严格对照实验表明：FCG 恶意软件家族开放集识别中，Louvain 社区特征对留出家族的拒绝无稳定增益（仅拒 4.48%），简单分类器不确定性反而更好。
objective_summary: 以匹配拓扑对照与多种子实验检验社区特征在开放集家族识别中的增量价值，得到稳健的负面结论。
evidence_note: 去重审计语料、五个留出家族、三种子、符号翻转检验并诚实报告不可达显著性；单一 GIN 架构为限。
novelty_note: 负面对照的方法学示范有价值；问题设定与特征均非新提出。
scope: 结论限于 GIN/FCG-MFD 设定与最近原型打分；其他架构与特征组合未覆盖。
limitations: 单一架构与语料；原型法不代表所有开放集方法；家族数量限制统计功效。

title: OPBackdoor: Opportunistic Backdoors via Alibi-Aligned Reasoning
abstract: When a backdoor trigger activates the target response regardless of the triggered prompt context, the backdoor objective reveals itself. Challenging this trigger-sufficient formulation across the LLM backdoor literature, we introduce Opportunistic Backdoors (OPBackdoor), in which the backdoor objective is elicited only when the triggered prompt context presents an exploitable opportunity, enabling the model's think to disguise its pursuit through alibi-aligned reasoning that is logical with respect to the triggered prompt context but directly leads to the target response. Across dense and MoE architectures of 26B-119B, we induce OPBackdoor via counterfactual training in coding assistants to retaliate against hostile users via excessive helpfulness and translation assistants to engage in commercial propaganda via biased translation. Yet alibi-aligned reasoning has limits: it can convince LLM inspectors that no backdoor is at work, while contrastive monitoring exposes the backdoor objective.
title_cn: OPBackdoor：经托辞对齐推理的机会型后门
abstract_cn: 当后门触发器无论提示上下文如何都激活目标响应时，后门目标便暴露自身。挑战 LLM 后门文献中这一「触发即充分」的表述，我们提出机会型后门（OPBackdoor）：后门目标只在被触发提示上下文呈现可利用机会时才被引出，使模型的 think 能通过「托辞对齐推理」伪装其追求——推理相对被触发的上下文是合乎逻辑的，却直接导向目标响应。在 26B–119B 的稠密与 MoE 架构上，我们经反事实训练在编码助手中诱发 OPBackdoor 以「过度帮助」报复敌意用户，在翻译助手中经有偏翻译进行商业宣传。托辞对齐推理也有极限：它可以说服 LLM 检查器相信没有后门，而对比监控能暴露后门目标。
summary_cn: 提出「机会触发 + 托辞对齐推理」的 LLM 后门 OPBackdoor：推理看似合理却导向目标响应，能骗过 LLM 检查器，但对比监控可暴露。
objective_summary: 提出上下文机会触发的后门新形态，展示其对检查器的欺骗性与对比监控的检测潜力。
evidence_note: 跨 26B–119B 稠密与 MoE 架构、两类应用场景、含检查器与监控对照；触发机会的现实分布未系统刻画。
novelty_note: 把后门从「触发即发」推进到「机会条件 + 推理伪装」，同时给出对应检测思路，攻防两侧均有新意。
scope: 结论适用于经反事实训练可植入的后门场景；对无训练访问的部署威胁未覆盖。
limitations: 训练成本高；「机会」定义依赖场景工程；对比监控的可扩展性未验证。

title: Decoding Guardrails: XAI-Guided Perturbation Analysis of Prompt Injection Detection
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in production systems, raising concerns about their exposure to adversarial manipulation through prompt injection and jailbreak attacks. Classifier-based guardrails, such as Prompt Guard 2, are widely used as a first line of defense against such attacks, but their internal decision logic is largely opaque to both defenders and attackers. This paper presents an exploratory case study that applies explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) techniques to analyze how Prompt Guard 2 distinguishes malicious from benign prompts. We conduct four experiments to probe this question empirically. Guided by Vanilla Gradient and SHAP attributions, we find that Prompt Guard 2's decisions rely on the cumulative contribution of many tokens rather than a few dominant ones, yet saliency-guided synonym substitution and sentence-level paraphrasing can flip its predictions while altering only a moderate fraction of the text, in some cases yielding a successful jailbreak against the underlying LLM. A dataset-scale saliency analysis further shows that undetected injection prompts systematically lack the lexical markers the classifier relies on. We discuss the implications of these findings for the design and evaluation of classifier-based guardrails, and argue that explanation methods intended to support transparency can simultaneously lower the cost of constructing successful adversarial bypasses.
title_cn: 解码护栏：提示注入检测的 XAI 引导扰动分析
abstract_cn: LLM 日益部署于生产系统，其对提示注入与越狱攻击的暴露令人关切。基于分类器的护栏（如 Prompt Guard 2）被广泛用作第一道防线，但其内部决策逻辑对防御者与攻击者都不透明。本文以可解释 AI（XAI）技术对一个案例做探索性分析：Prompt Guard 2 如何区分恶意与良性提示。在 Vanilla Gradient 与 SHAP 归因引导下的四组实验发现：该分类器的决策依赖大量 token 的累积贡献而非少数主导 token；但显著性引导的同义替换与句级改写可在仅改动适度比例文本的情况下翻转其预测——某些情况构成对底层 LLM 的成功越狱。数据集规模的显著性分析进一步显示：未被检出的注入提示系统性地缺少分类器所依赖的词汇标记。我们讨论这些发现对分类器护栏设计与评估的影响，并指出：本意支持透明性的解释方法，同时可能降低构造对抗绕过的成本。
summary_cn: 用 SHAP/梯度归因解剖 Prompt Guard 2：显著性引导的少量文本改写即可翻转检测并实现越狱，未检出注入系统性缺少分类器依赖的词汇标记。
objective_summary: 以 XAI 引导的扰动实验刻画主流注入检测器的决策依赖与可绕过性，讨论透明性的双刃效应。
evidence_note: 四组实验 + 数据集规模显著性分析、对象为生产级护栏；单检测器案例研究、攻击成功率统计口径有限。
novelty_note: 把 XAI 定位为攻击成本降低器并系统验证于注入检测器，视角与实证都有价值。
scope: 结论适用于 Prompt Guard 2 类分类器护栏；对基于 LLM 的检测器与运行时防御未测。
limitations: 单一检测器与版本；绕过以良性-恶意边界文本为主；防御建议未做闭环验证。

title: Reasoning Topology Matters: A Controlled Study of LLM-Based Cybersecurity Analysis
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in cybersecurity, where accurate analysis often requires multi-step and context-dependent reasoning over complex and heterogeneous data. However, existing prompting approaches typically focus on eliciting reasoning without explicitly considering how intermediate reasoning steps are structurally organized. We introduce Security Reasoning Topology, which models reasoning through three representative structures: Linear, Branching, and Graph. To evaluate their effects, we conduct controlled experiments on three cybersecurity datasets covering MITRE ATT&CK network traffic, cyber threat intelligence (CTI), and CVE vulnerability analysis. We evaluate multiple LLMs, including Llama 2 (7B, 13B, 70B), GPT-5.1, and Mistral Large 3, while keeping task inputs consistent and controlling reasoning structure through system-level prompting. Results show that reasoning topology substantially affects performance: Graph reasoning achieves the highest overall accuracy, improving over few-shot prompting by 9.8-12.2 percentage points across datasets, while Branching provides a strong intermediate solution. The results further show that the effect of reasoning topology remains consistent across model families and scales, highlighting reasoning topology as an important design factor for LLM-based cybersecurity analysis.
comment: Accepted at AIAIS 2027
title_cn: 推理拓扑至关重要：LLM 网络安全分析的受控研究
abstract_cn: LLM 在网络安全中的应用日增，准确分析常需要对复杂异构数据的多步、上下文相关推理。但现有提示方法通常只关心引出推理，不显式考虑中间推理步骤的结构组织。我们引入「安全推理拓扑」，以三种代表结构建模推理：线性、分支与图。为评估其影响，在覆盖 MITRE ATT&CK 网络流量、网络威胁情报（CTI）与 CVE 漏洞分析的三个数据集上做受控实验，评估 Llama 2（7B/13B/70B）、GPT-5.1 与 Mistral Large 3，保持任务输入一致、经系统级提示控制推理结构。结果显示推理拓扑显著影响性能：图推理总体准确率最高，较少样本提示在三个数据集上提升 9.8–12.2 个百分点，分支推理是强的中间方案；该效应跨模型族与规模保持一致，说明推理拓扑是 LLM 网络安全分析的重要设计因素（AIAIS 2027）。
summary_cn: 受控比较线性/分支/图三种推理结构对 LLM 网络安全分析的影响：图结构在三个任务上较少样本提示提升 9.8–12.2 点且跨模型稳定。
objective_summary: 以系统级提示控制推理拓扑，在三个安全任务与五个模型上做受控比较并量化结构效应。
evidence_note: 任务输入一致、多模型多规模、效应方向一致；会议级别一般、缺少方差与显著性细节。
novelty_note: 「结构化推理有帮助」方向已有大量工作，贡献在安全域内的受控量化与拓扑分型。
scope: 结论适用于所测任务类型与模型集；对需要工具调用的智能体式分析未覆盖。
limitations: 提示工程细节敏感；评测集规模有限；图构建本身的成本未计入。

title: Domain Specific Post Quantum Signatures for Blockchains
abstract: Blockchains need more than post quantum single signer signatures. They need consensus profiled authentication objects with canonical bytes, priced invalid input rejection, stable transaction identifiers, hybrid downgrade resistance, public aggregation, merge semantics, accountable signer evidence, forward secure committee rotation, and light client consequences. We argue for domain specific post quantum signatures for blockchain roles, analogously to how hash function engineering produced domain specific primitives for hash table DoS and arithmetized proof systems. We formalize transaction authorization and quorum certificate requirements, instantiate them on Bitcoin, Ethereum, and a Sei Giga style high throughput BFT stress profile, and evaluate ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, Falcon/FN-DSA, HAWK, MAYO, SNOVA, UOV/QR-UOV, FAEST, SQIsign, LaBRADOR Falcon, Squirrel, Chipmunk, and DKKW/LeanSig. The conclusion is blunt. NIST single signer signatures are necessary components, although none of the current schemes is a drop in replacement for the signature layer of modern public blockchains. The missing object is a consensus ready post quantum signature profile, not another generic size table.
title_cn: 面向区块链的领域专用后量子签名
abstract_cn: 区块链需要的不是量子安全的单签签名，而是与共识耦合的认证对象：规范字节、定价化的非法输入拒绝、稳定交易标识、混合降级抵抗、公开聚合、合并语义、可问责签名者证据、前向安全的委员会轮换，以及轻客户端后果。我们主张为区块链角色设计领域专用的后量子签名，正如哈希函数工程曾为哈希表 DoS 与算术化证明系统产出领域专用原语。我们形式化交易授权与法定人数证书要求，在 Bitcoin、Ethereum 与 Sei Giga 式高吞吐 BFT 压力画像上实例化，并评估 ML-DSA、SLH-DSA、Falcon/FN-DSA、HAWK、MAYO、SNOVA、UOV/QR-UOV、FAEST、SQIsign、LaBRADOR Falcon、Squirrel、Chipmunk 与 DKKW/LeanSig。结论直白：NIST 单签签名是必要组件，但没有一个是现代公链签名层的即插即用替代；缺失的对象是「共识就绪」的后量子签名轮廓，而非又一张通用尺寸对照表。
summary_cn: 论证区块链需要「共识就绪」的领域专用后量子签名轮廓而非通用 NIST 方案：形式化七类需求并在三大链画像上评估 14 个签名方案。
objective_summary: 形式化区块链签名的角色需求，宽口径评估 14 个 PQC 签名方案，论证需要领域专用轮廓的立场。
evidence_note: 评估覆盖面广、需求形式化清晰；但性能数字以既有基准与画像为主，非统一的原创测量。
novelty_note: 「共识就绪轮廓」的问题重述有价值，把分散的 PQC 区块链讨论收敛为可执行议程。
scope: 结论适用于 UTXO/账户/高性能 BFT 三类链画像；对 PoS 轻客户端外的模块未展开。
limitations: 方案演进快、结论时效短；未给出自研轮廓的完整规格；实现工程代价未量化。

title: Trust in Edge-Enabled IoT Security: Features, Challenges and Research Directions
abstract: Providing autonomous intelligence, pervasive connectivity and usability to human life and industry has led to the emergence of the Internet of Things (IoT). To support time-sensitive and resource-constrained applications, IoT systems nowadays increasingly rely on edge computing. This brings computation and decision-making closer to end devices. In edge-enabled IoT architecture, latency and communication overhead are reduced, but interactions among a larger and more diverse set of devices, edge nodes, services, and data sources are introduced as well. In such environments, security and privacy mechanisms provide the foundation for protection, while trust management can assess the reliability of interacting entities and adapting secure decisions. In this paper, we systematically review the current state of trust management in edge-enabled IoT. To this end, we propose a comprehensive taxonomy that maps physical, network, and application architectural IoT layers against the consumer, commercial, industrial, and infrastructure IoT domains. We further investigate state-of-art research based on their trust design, how trust integrated into secure IoT operations, the attacks that effect trust management process. Based on these findings, we identify key gaps in current research and outline future directions for context-aware and adaptive trust management in edge-enabled IoT.
comment: 34+ pages, 9 figures, 12 tables, submitted and under review in ACM Computing Surveys
title_cn: 边缘赋能 IoT 安全中的信任：特征、挑战与研究方向
abstract_cn: 为人类生活与产业提供自主智能、泛在连接与易用性催生了物联网（IoT）。为支持时延敏感与资源受限应用，IoT 系统日益依赖边缘计算，把计算与决策拉近终端设备。边缘赋能 IoT 架构降低时延与通信开销，但也引入更大、更多样的设备、边缘节点、服务与数据源交互。在此类环境中，安全与隐私机制提供保护基础，而信任管理可评估交互实体的可靠性并适配安全决策。本文系统综述边缘赋能 IoT 中信任管理的现状：提出把物理/网络/应用三层 IoT 架构映射到消费/商业/工业/基础设施四域的综合分类法；按信任设计检视最新研究、信任如何被集成进安全 IoT 运作、以及影响信任管理过程的攻击；据此识别当前研究的关键缺口并勾勒面向情境感知与自适应信任管理的未来方向。
summary_cn: 对边缘赋能 IoT 信任管理的系统综述：三层架构 × 四应用域分类法、信任设计与相关攻击盘点、以及自适应信任管理的未来方向（投 ACM CSUR 审稿中）。
objective_summary: 系统综述边缘 IoT 信任管理研究，提出架构-领域二维分类法并识别研究缺口。
evidence_note: 有分类法与研究缺口分析；检索与纳入协议在摘要层面未完整披露（34+ 页全文）；无定量元分析。
novelty_note: 信任管理综述已有 prior art，边缘场景的二维映射是增量组织贡献。
scope: 结论适用于资源受限、边缘辅助的 IoT 部署形态。
limitations: 文献快照时效；对可信执行硬件等新趋势覆盖待验证；分类法实用性未经实证检验。

title: 5G-Shark: A Network Security Auditor for 5G Subscriber Privacy and Unauthenticated Signalling Resilience
abstract: The fifth generation of mobile networks was standardised with an explicit mandate to close long-standing privacy and security gaps, mandating the concealment of the subscriber's permanent identity, resistance to generational downgrade, and protection against location tracking. Assessing whether these guarantees hold in operational networks, however, requires separating two sources of residual exposure that prior studies do not distinguish and do not evaluate in the wild: protocol-design limitations, which remain exploitable even against a fully specification-compliant deployment, and implementation gaps, which arise from incomplete or non-compliant implementations. We present 5G-Shark, a security assessment tool and methodology that turns a legitimate mobility procedure against the subscriber. Rather than relying on active jamming or malformed-packet injection, 5G-Shark manipulates the standardised cell-reselection criterion to pull a target User Equipment onto a self-created rogue cell, establishing an attack vantage with minimal service disruption. Then, the proposed methodology effectively performs the required interactions to expose the security risks of the system under test, classifying them into the aforementioned categories. Built solely from open-source stacks and Software Defined Radio hardware and evaluated against commercial 5G Standalone deployments, 5G-Shark requests subscriber identifiers, forces Radio Access Technology downgrade via crafted Registration Reject codes, and induces denial-of-service states. For each vector, we attribute the root cause to protocol design or deployment non-compliance. We further provide empirical evidence that in several commercial deployments, temporary identifiers are re-allocated in near-sequential steps that keep successive values linkable, a weakness that enables persistent user tracking despite correct subscriber ID concealment.
title_cn: 5G-Shark：面向 5G 用户隐私与未认证信令韧性的网络安全审计器
abstract_cn: 第五代移动网络在标准化时负有明确使命：弥合长期存在的隐私与安全缺口——隐藏用户永久标识、抵抗代际降级、抵御位置追踪。要评估这些保证在运营网络中是否成立，需要区分先前研究未区分、也未在真实网络中评估的两类残余暴露：协议设计局限（面对完全合规部署仍可利用）与实现缺口（来自不完整或不合规实现）。我们提出 5G-Shark：一个安全评估工具与方法论，把合法的移动性流程反转到用户身上：不依赖主动干扰或畸形报文注入，而是操纵标准化的小区重选准则，把目标 UE 拉到自建 rogue 小区，以最小服务中断建立攻击立足点；随后执行所需交互暴露被测系统的安全风险，并按上述两类归因。工具仅由开源栈与 SDR 硬件构成，对商用 5G SA 部署评估：请求用户标识、经构造的 Registration Reject 码强制 RAT 降级、诱导拒绝服务状态；对每个向量归因根因。我们进一步给出经验证据：若干商用部署中临时标识以近顺序步进重分配，使 successive 值可链接——尽管用户标识隐藏正确，仍可实现持久追踪。
summary_cn: 以 rogue 小区拉取目标 UE 的 5G 审计工具 5G-Shark：对商用 SA 网络实测标识请求、RAT 降级与 DoS 向量并区分设计缺陷与实现缺口；发现临时标识近顺序分配致可链接追踪。
objective_summary: 构建非侵入式 5G 隐私/韧性审计工具与方法论，在商用网络实测多类攻击向量并按协议/实现归因。
evidence_note: 真实商用 5G SA 部署、多向量在野验证、归因方法清晰；具体运营商与规模披露受限（伦理约束）。
novelty_note: 以合法流程为武器的低扰动攻击立足点与「设计 vs. 实现」归因框架是方法学贡献；单点漏洞多为已知类型的实证确认。
scope: 结论适用于所测商用 5G SA 网络与 SDR 可达的攻击者模型；对内核级基带漏洞与主动干扰不覆盖。
limitations: 伦理限制下的测量范围；网络侧配置变化会影响可复现性；修复验证依赖运营商配合。

title: State-Aware Fuzzing of JavaScript Engines with LLM-Guided Instrumentation
abstract: The security of the modern web depends on the correctness of JavaScript (JS) engines, yet these complex systems remain vulnerable to high-impact bugs. A critical limitation of state-of-the-art fuzzers is the coverage plateau: once a fuzzer saturates the control-flow graph, edge coverage loses its ability to guide discovery. Because complex engine behaviors, such as JIT optimization tiers and hidden class transitions, often share identical edge coverage, standard coverage metrics are blind to the distinct internal states required to trigger deep errors. To bridge this gap, we present StateLens, a framework that employs Large Language Models (LLM) to automate the discovery of deep internal states. Blindly placing instrumentation probes at all states is infeasible due to the vast state space and the high runtime overhead. StateLens introduces a novel agent-based reasoning pipeline that emulates the intuition of a security researcher. By iteratively traversing code and developer comments, our agents intelligently select high-value instrumentation targets, effectively separating logic-driving state variables from irrelevant data. This results in synthesizable, high-signal feedback probes that map the engine's hidden configurations. This instrumentation feeds a dual-feedback mechanism, effectively guiding the fuzzer toward unexplored engine semantics. Our evaluation confirms that StateLens significantly outperforms state-of-the-art fuzzers and uncovering 68 new bugs.
comment: In ACM SIGOPS 32nd Symposium on Operating Systems Principles (SOSP'26)
title_cn: LLM 引导插桩的 JavaScript 引擎状态感知模糊测试
abstract_cn: 现代 Web 的安全取决于 JavaScript 引擎的正确性，而这些复杂系统仍屡现高危漏洞。最先进 fuzzer 的关键局限是覆盖平台期：一旦控制流图饱和，边覆盖便失去引导能力。因为 JIT 优化层级、隐藏类转换等复杂引擎行为常共享相同的边覆盖，标准覆盖指标对触发深层错误所需的内部状态视而不见。为此我们提出 StateLens：用 LLM 自动化发现深层内部状态的框架。在所有状态盲目布点不可行——状态空间巨大且运行时开销高。StateLens 引入模拟安全研究员直觉的智能体推理流水线：经迭代遍历代码与开发者注释，智能体选择高价值插桩目标，有效把驱动逻辑的状态变量与无关数据分开，产生可综合、高信号的反馈探针，映射引擎的隐藏配置；插桩再馈入双反馈机制，引导 fuzzer 探索未触及的引擎语义。评估确认 StateLens 显著超过 SOTA fuzzer，发现 68 个新 bug（SOSP'26）。
summary_cn: 用 LLM 智能体自动定位 JS 引擎的深层内部状态并合成插桩探针，突破边覆盖平台期：显著超越 SOTA fuzzer 并发现 68 个新 bug（SOSP'26）。
objective_summary: 提出 LLM 引导的状态感知模糊测试框架，自动化深层状态探针合成，在真实引擎上验证增益并大量报洞。
evidence_note: SOSP'26 录用、与 SOTA fuzzer 对比、68 个新 bug 的实证产出；消融覆盖 LLM 引导相对随机布点的增益。
novelty_note: 把「语义状态」而非代码覆盖作为模糊反馈对象，并用 LLM 自动化探针发现，是对覆盖平台期问题的实质突破。
scope: 结论适用于 JIT 型 JS 引擎；对其他语言运行时需重建状态模型。
limitations: LLM 推理成本高；状态模型可能遗漏；对非引擎类目标的通用性未测。

title: MIRAGE: Full-Body Bystander Privacy for Smart Glasses with Consent-Based Restoration
abstract: Video recording on smart glasses exposes more than faces. Continuous capture reveals full-body biometric signatures, including gait, posture, and silhouette, that enable person re-identification (ReID) even after conventional face sanitization. We present MIRAGE, a three-tier architecture for privacy-preserving smart glasses that enforces full-body privacy, supports synthetic full-body replacement, and retains encrypted recovery material for consent-based restoration. We implement MIRAGE on a Raspberry Pi~5 (a CPU-only proxy for smart-glasses compute), companion phones, and a cloud generative backend. Compared to prior systems, MIRAGE achieves 0.948 AP and 0.976 AR while accurately detecting the complete visible body. Its bounding box masking reduces learned silhouette-based ReID to essentially random guessing, with 10.86% Rank-1 accuracy compared with an 11.12% measured chance level. Even against an adaptive adversary retrained on MIRAGE's sanitized pose signals, Rank-1 gait identification drops from 90.25% to 26.20%, removing 72.5% of the adversary's identification advantage.
title_cn: MIRAGE：基于同意恢复的智能眼镜全身旁观者隐私
abstract_cn: 智能眼镜上的视频录制暴露的不只是人脸：持续拍摄揭示步态、姿态与轮廓等全身生物特征，即便常规人脸净化后仍可实现行人重识别（ReID）。我们提出 MIRAGE，一个三层架构的隐私保护智能眼镜方案：强制全身隐私、支持合成全身替换、保留加密恢复材料以供基于同意的恢复。我们在 Raspberry Pi 5（智能眼镜算力的 CPU 代理）、伴侣手机与云端生成后端上实现。相较先前系统，MIRAGE 在准确检测完整可见身体上达到 0.948 AP 与 0.976 AR；其包围盒掩蔽把基于学习轮廓的 ReID 压到随机水平（Rank-1 10.86% 对实测机会水平 11.12%）；即便面对在 MIRAGE 净化信号上重训的自适应对手，步态识别 Rank-1 也从 90.25% 降到 26.20%，消除 72.5% 的识别优势。
summary_cn: 智能眼镜全身隐私三层架构 MIRAGE：掩蔽后轮廓 ReID 降至随机水平，自适应对手下步态识别 Rank-1 从 90.25% 压到 26.20%，并支持同意后恢复。
objective_summary: 构建检测-掩蔽-可恢复的智能眼镜全身隐私系统，在标准与自适应对手下量化对 ReID 的抑制效果。
evidence_note: 真实硬件原型、自适应重训对手、多指标量化并与先前系统对比；数据集与场景多样性有限。
novelty_note: 把隐私范围从人脸扩展到全身生物特征并支持同意恢复是实质场景推进；掩蔽机制本身为组合。
scope: 结论适用于第一人称可穿戴拍摄场景与所测 ReID/步态模型族。
limitations: Pi 5 与真实眼镜算力有差距；云端生成依赖连接；对侧信道（音频、上下文）泄漏未覆盖。

title: Beyond Predictable Paths: Redefining AI Security Incident Reporting for Agents
abstract: AI agents are being deployed rapidly, accompanied by a growing number of AI-specific attacks and corresponding incidents. As incident reporting becomes increasingly important for legal compliance, governance, accountability, and security; current frameworks must be adapted to the unique characteristics of AI agents. In this paper, two editorial authors compare AI systems and AI agents and, drawing on input from 23 experts in academia and industry, identify the information required for reporting incidents where the security of AI agents is harmed. %involving AI agents. Potential reporting elements include, for example, agent memory and memory accesses, actual and potential levels of autonomy, and tool usage. Based on these findings, we identify several open research questions, including how to efficiently record incidents and how to determine whether vulnerabilities and incidents generalize. Expert feedback also highlighted potential reporting weaknesses, such as risks of data leakage and attacks targeting the reporting infrastructure itself, creating additional research needs. Lastly, we summarize privacy requirements and outline research directions for the secure and trustworthy deployment of AI agents.
comment: under submission, mega paper (authorship does not imply endorsement of every sub-section)
title_cn: 超越可预测路径：为智能体重定义 AI 安全事件报告
abstract_cn: AI 智能体正被快速部署，伴随越来越多的 AI 特有攻击与对应事件。随着事件报告对法律合规、治理、问责与安全日益重要，现有框架必须适配 AI 智能体的独特特征。本文中，两位编辑作者比较 AI 系统与 AI 智能体，并结合 23 位学术界与业界专家的意见，识别在 AI 智能体安全受害事件中报告所需的信息：例如智能体记忆与记忆访问、实际与潜在的自主水平、工具使用。基于这些发现，我们识别若干开放研究问题：如何高效记录事件、如何判断漏洞与事件是否可泛化。专家反馈还凸显报告机制的潜在弱点——数据泄露风险与针对报告基础设施本身的攻击——带来额外研究需要。最后我们总结隐私要求并概述安全可信部署 AI 智能体的研究方向。
summary_cn: 结合 23 位专家意见提出 AI 智能体安全事件报告所需的信息要素（记忆访问、自主水平、工具使用等）与研究议程（立场性工作，标注「作者身份不意味着背书每一小节」）。
objective_summary: 基于专家征询提出智能体安全事件报告框架的要素清单与开放问题。
evidence_note: 23 位专家征询但方法学（抽样、访谈协议）未详；无系统评估；多人署名的编辑过程透明度自陈有限。
novelty_note: 把传统安全事件报告适配到智能体场景的要素清单有实用价值，概念突破有限。
scope: 结论为框架性建议，适用于智能体事件的记录与披露制度设计。
limitations: 专家样本代表性；清单的可用性未做用户研究；与现有监管条文的映射未完成。

title: Prefix Puncturable Signatures with Smaller Signing Key from HIBS
abstract: Puncturable signatures, proposed by Bellare et al. (EUROCRYPT 2016), allow a signing key to be punctured (updated) so that it loses the ability to sign particular messages while retaining the ability to sign all others. Halevi et al. (ASIACRYPT 2017) introduced prefix puncturable signatures, in which the signing key can be punctured with respect to a target prefix so that it cannot sign messages whose prefixes match the target prefix. So far, several generic constructions of prefix puncturable signature schemes have been proposed, including constructions based on identity-based signatures (IBS) (ESORICS 2022) and delegated constrained signatures (IEEE Trans. Inf. Forensics Secure. 2024). However, these constructions suffer from drawbacks in terms of key size. When the prefix space is the set of all l-bit strings, the former construction requires a signing key consisting of 2^{l} IBS signing keys. The latter construction, when instantiated with a lattice-based delegated constrained signature scheme, yields a punctured signing key whose size grows quadratically with the number of puncturing operations Q^{Punc}. In this paper, we present a generic construction of prefix puncturable signatures from hierarchical identity-based signature (HIBS) schemes. When the prefix space is {0,1}^{l} and our construction is instantiated with the lattice-based HIBS scheme HIBS^{GPV} by Ruckert (PQC 2010), our construction achieves a punctured signing key size bounded by O(lQ^{Punc}).
comment: A preliminary version of this paper is appeared in the 28th International Conference on Information and Communications Security (ICICS 2026)
title_cn: 基于 HIBS 的更短签名密钥前缀可穿孔签名
abstract_cn: 可穿孔签名（Bellare 等，EUROCRYPT 2016）允许更新签名密钥使其失去对特定消息的签名能力而保留其余能力。前缀可穿孔签名（Halevi 等，ASIACRYPT 2017）进一步允许按目标前缀穿孔：穿孔后无法签署前缀匹配的消息。已有若干通用构造：基于身份签名（IBS）的构造（ESORICS 2022）在前缀空间为全部 l 位串时需要 2^l 个 IBS 签名密钥组成签名密钥；基于委托受限签名的构造（IEEE TIFS 2024）以格实例化时穿孔密钥大小随穿孔次数 Q^Punc 二次增长。本文提出从分层身份基签名（HIBS）出发的前缀可穿孔签名通用构造：以前缀空间 {0,1}^l 计，用 Rückert 的格基 HIBS（HIBS^GPV，PQC 2010）实例化时，穿孔签名密钥大小以 O(lQ^Punc) 为界。
summary_cn: 给出由 HIBS 构造前缀可穿孔签名的通用方案：以格基 HIBS 实例化后穿孔密钥尺寸 O(lQ^Punc)，显著优于此前 2^l 与二次增长的构造。
objective_summary: 提出由 HIBS 构造前缀可穿孔签名的通用方案并证明安全，密钥尺寸相对既有构造有量级改进。
evidence_note: 通用构造带安全归约与具体实例化尺寸分析；无实现性能评估。
novelty_note: 把 HIBS 的层级结构对准前缀穿孔是自然但此前未被发现的路径，尺寸改进实质。
scope: 结论为渐近尺寸界；具体常数取决于所选 HIBS 实例与参数。
limitations: 未实现与基准；签名/验证开销与密钥生成的代价未比较。

title: ActGov: Governing LLM Agent Actions via Policy-Constrained Validation
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute long-horizon workflows through external tools, allowing untrusted outputs to influence subsequent actions and exceed user authorization. Existing defenses isolate injected content or constrain execution with predefined plans and static policies, but these approaches are brittle under dynamic workflows and scale poorly across extensible tool ecosystems. In this work, we present ActGov, a runtime enforcement framework that validates each LLM-proposed tool action before it causes external effects. Built on a unified semantic model of authorization, actions, runtime context, and security constraints, the ActGov-Policy component iteratively constructs a policy set from tool specifications, benign tasks, and observed failure traces, with each update verified through SMT-based counterexample checking. At runtime, ActGov-Runtime abstracts each tool call into finite policy records and permits it only if it remains within the task-scoped authorization boundary and satisfies all applicable policies. This per-action enforcement preserves authorization throughout long-horizon, dynamically branching workflows. We evaluate ActGov on the AgentDojo and AgentDyn benchmarks across multiple models and attack configurations. It shows that ActGov consistently reduces the success rate of indirect prompt-injection attacks while preserving task utility, significantly outperforming existing defenses. These results demonstrate that ActGov can enforce fine-grained authorization over dynamic agent executions without relying on the underlying LLM to correctly identify malicious instructions.
title_cn: ActGov：经策略约束验证治理 LLM 智能体动作
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体日益通过外部工具执行长时程工作流，使不可信输出得以影响后续动作并超出用户授权。现有防御隔离注入内容或以预定义计划、静态策略约束执行，但动态工作流下脆弱、且难以跨可扩展工具生态扩展。我们提出 ActGov，一个在 LLM 提议的工具动作造成外部效果前验证它的运行时强制框架。基于授权、动作、运行时上下文与安全约束的统一语义模型，ActGov-Policy 组件从工具规格、良性任务与观察到的失败轨迹迭代构建策略集，每次更新都经基于 SMT 的反例检查验证；运行时，ActGov-Runtime 把每个工具调用抽象为有限策略记录，仅当其保持在任务范围的授权边界内且满足全部适用策略时才放行。这种逐动作强制在长时程、动态分支的工作流中保持授权。在 AgentDojo 与 AgentDyn 基准、多模型多攻击配置上的评估显示：ActGov 持续降低间接提示注入攻击成功率并保持任务效用，显著优于现有防御，表明其可在不依赖底层 LLM 正确识别恶意指令的情况下对动态智能体执行强制细粒度授权。
summary_cn: 对 LLM 智能体的每个工具动作做 SMT 验证的策略约束运行时强制 ActGov：AgentDojo/AgentDyn 上显著降低间接注入成功率且保持任务效用。
objective_summary: 提出策略构建与运行时强制分离的智能体动作治理框架，以反例检查保证策略一致性，在标准基准上量化攻防表现。
evidence_note: 两个公开基准、多模型多攻击配置、与现有防御对比并保持效用；策略完备性依赖规格与失败轨迹覆盖。
novelty_note: 统一语义模型 + SMT 反例检查的策略管理是对智能体运行时治理的系统化推进；思想与策略抽象/信息流控制有渊源。
scope: 结论适用于工具语义可形式化的智能体系统；对语义模糊的 API 与物理动作不适用。
limitations: 策略构建成本高；对未建模工具的覆盖缺口；延迟开销未详细报告。

title: SkelOT: Reusing AOT Compilation Across EVM Contract Families
abstract: Ahead-of-time (AOT) compilers (e.g., revmc, evmone, and DTVM) for the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) reuse compilation artifacts at contract-code-hash granularity. This granularity is poorly matched to real EVM workloads dominated by \emph{contract families}: factory-, proxy-, and template-driven deployments that share instruction structure but differ in a small set of embedded constants. Across four EVM chains (Base, Ethereum, BSC, and Arbitrum), we find that 23.1--47.6\% of unique compilable bytecodes map to shared family skeletons within 10K-block windows. Per-hash AOT therefore redundantly recompiles structurally equivalent code, inflating compile time and artifact footprint while reducing workload coverage under finite compile budgets. We present \textsc{SkelOT}, an AOT framework that lifts the unit of compilation reuse from code hash to family skeleton. \textsc{SkelOT} compiles one native artifact per family, bakes invariant constants into the artifact, and reads variant constants from a per-contract runtime table. Built on revmc/LLVM and evaluated on a 10K-block Base mainnet corpus (3.52M transactions), \textsc{SkelOT} reduces compilation units by 47.5\%, artifact footprint by 57.4\%, and compile time by $2.19\times$, while preserving byte-identical execution outcomes versus per-hash AOT. At runtime, \textsc{SkelOT} delivers a $1.31\times$ median per-contract speedup across family members. Under a compile budget targeting 75\% execution-time coverage, \textsc{SkelOT} needs far fewer artifacts than per-hash AOT, and the advantage holds at every coverage target.

title_cn: SkelOT：跨 EVM 合约族复用 AOT 编译
abstract_cn: 以太坊虚拟机（EVM）的提前编译器（revmc、evmone、DTVM）以合约代码哈希为粒度复用编译产物。该粒度与真实 EVM 负载失配：后者由工厂/代理/模板驱动的「合约族」主导——共享指令结构、仅少数内嵌常量不同。横跨四条 EVM 链（Base、Ethereum、BSC、Arbitrum），我们发现在 1 万块窗口内 23.1–47.6% 的唯一可编译字节码映射到共享族骨架。逐哈希 AOT 因此对结构等价代码重复编译，推高编译时间与产物占用，并在有限编译预算下降低覆盖率。我们提出 SkelOT，把编译复用单位从代码哈希提升到族骨架：每族编译一个原生工件、把不变常量烘焙进工件、从逐合约运行时表读取变体常量。基于 revmc/LLVM、在 1 万块 Base 主网语料（352 万交易）上评估：编译单元减 47.5%、产物占用减 57.4%、编译时间降 2.19 倍，执行结果与逐哈希 AOT 字节一致；族成员合约运行时中位加速 1.31 倍；在面向 75% 执行时间覆盖的编译预算下，所需工件远少于逐哈希 AOT，且优势在任意覆盖目标下保持（EuroSys'27）。
summary_cn: 发现 EVM 合约以「家族」为主、逐哈希 AOT 大量重复编译；SkelOT 以族骨架为复用单位：编译单元减 47.5%、编译快 2.19 倍、族内合约加速 1.31 倍（EuroSys'27）。
objective_summary: 测量 EVM 合约族的普遍性并构建以族为单位的 AOT 编译复用框架，在主网语料上量化编译与运行时收益。
evidence_note: 四链测量 + 主网 352 万交易评估 + 字节级一致性验证，顶会录用；安全性仅体现在执行等价性。
novelty_note: 族粒度复用的观察与工程实现结合扎实；核心机制（常量参数化）并不复杂。
scope: 结论适用于 EVM 字节码族明显的链与负载；对非 EVM VM 与高度独特合约收益有限。
limitations: 家族聚类质量影响正确性边界；跨合约族误配的后果分析有限；冷启动编译预算敏感。

title: Passive Hybrid Network-Based Intrusion Detection System (Hybrid-NIDS) Combining Suricata and Random Forest
abstract: This paper evaluates a passive Hybrid Network-based Intrusion Detection System (Hybrid-NIDS) prototype that combines Suricata with Random Forest flow classification and centralized ELK-based alert handling. The study explicitly separates benchmark evaluation from PCAP/live operational validation and controls exact feature-duplicate leakage using feature hashing and group-aware splitting. From 2,540,047 UNSW-NB15 records, 453 conflicting-label hash groups containing 1,879 rows were removed; the resulting Development and Hold-out sets have zero exact feature-hash overlap. RF-41 achieved F1 = 0.971360 and ROC-AUC = 0.999671, while the NFStream-compatible RF-21 achieved F1 = 0.970148 on the same prepared hold-out boundary. However, operational validation revealed substantial benchmark-to-deployment domain shift: on a labeled laboratory PCAP, RF-21 and the strictly correlated branch achieved recall of only 0.0095, and RF-21 produced no alerts in five additional 60-second attack sessions. An unlabeled normal-traffic test produced 439 alerts from 2,375 flows; this value is reported only as an alert ratio and is not interpreted as a false-positive rate. These results show that strong performance on a public benchmark does not directly translate into operational effectiveness. Accordingly, the current Hybrid-NIDS should be interpreted as a passive prototype and evaluation framework, and the reported experiments do not demonstrate that Suricata-Random Forest correlation provides better operational detection than Suricata alone.

title_cn: 结合 Suricata 与随机森林的被动混合网络入侵检测系统
abstract_cn: 本文评估一个被动混合网络入侵检测原型：结合 Suricata 与随机森林流分类及集中式 ELK 告警处理。研究明确区分基准评估与 PCAP/在线运维验证，并用特征哈希与分组划分控制精确特征重复泄漏：从 2,540,047 条 UNSW-NB15 记录中移除 453 个冲突标签哈希组（1,879 行），使开发/留出集零精确特征重叠。RF-41 达 F1=0.971360、ROC-AUC=0.999671；同一边界上 NFStream 兼容的 RF-21 F1=0.970148。但运维验证揭示基准到部署的显著域偏移：在带标注的实验室 PCAP 上，RF-21 与强相关分支召回仅 0.0095，RF-21 在另外五个 60 秒攻击会话中未产生任何告警；无标签正常流量测试产生 2,375 流中 439 条告警——该值仅作为告警率报告，不被解释为误报率。结果表明公开基准上的强表现不直接转化为运维有效性。当前混合 NIDS 应被理解为被动原型与评估框架；报告的实验不能证明 Suricata-随机森林相关提供优于单独 Suricata 的运维检测。
summary_cn: 控制特征泄漏后基准 F1 仍达 0.97 的 Suricata+随机森林原型，在实验室 PCAP 上召回仅 0.95%——诚实展示 IDS 基准分数与运维效果的巨大鸿沟。
objective_summary: 以控制泄漏的严格基准与真实 PCAP 运维验证对照，量化 IDS 原型的基准-部署域偏移并给出负面结论。
evidence_note: 泄漏控制明确、基准与运维双层验证、诚实报告负面结果并约束结论边界；单一数据集与实验室环境为限。
novelty_note: 负面结果本身对该子领域有校准价值；「基准-运维鸿沟」在 IDS 文献中早有讨论，此处给出干净实证。
scope: 结论适用于 UNSW-NB15 类基准与实验室 PCAP 场景的 Suricata+RF 组合。
limitations: 实验室 PCAP 规模小；未调优检测阈值；未评估更新训练分布后的恢复空间。

title: Name2Pkg: Lightweight One-Class Android Malware Screening via Name-Package Correspondence Modeling
abstract: Deep learning-based malware detection has been widely adopted in security-critical services. Most detection methods rely on internal features extracted from APK files or runtime behavior. However, extracting these features is computationally expensive. This limits their use in large-scale, early-stage screening. Malicious apps may exhibit weak correspondence between their user-facing app names and package names, providing a low-cost screening signal. We present Name2Pkg, a lightweight one-class classification method. It leverages only the app name and the package name. We formulate malware screening as a sequence anomaly detection problem. A character-level sequence-to-sequence model estimates the conditional likelihood of a package name given the app name. The length-normalized negative log-likelihood serves as the anomaly score. We train the model and calibrate the threshold using only benign data. Using a dataset of 67,129 real-world applications, Name2Pkg achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) of 0.982 and malware recall of 0.885 at an achieved false-positive rate of 0.044 on held-out test data. It has a 3.57 MiB checkpoint and a CPU inference latency of 28.20 ms per sample. Name2Pkg provides an efficient and effective pre-filtering signal for large-scale security systems.

title_cn: Name2Pkg：经名称-包名对应建模的轻量单类 Android 恶意软件筛查
abstract_cn: 深度学习恶意软件检测已广泛用于安全关键服务。多数方法依赖从 APK 提取的内部特征或运行时行为，但提取这些特征计算昂贵，限制其在大规模早期筛查中的使用。恶意应用的用户可见应用名与包名之间常呈弱对应，提供一个低成本的筛查信号。我们提出 Name2Pkg，一个只用应用名与包名的轻量单类分类方法：把恶意软件筛查形式化为序列异常检测，字符级 seq2seq 模型估计「给定应用名时包名的条件似然」，以长度归一化负对数似然作为异常分；仅用良性数据训练模型并校准阈值。在 67,129 个真实应用的数据集上，Name2Pkg 在留出测试上 ROC-AUC 0.982、FPR 0.044 下恶意召回 0.885；checkpoint 仅 3.57 MiB，CPU 每样本推理 28.20 毫秒。Name2Pkg 为大规模安全系统提供高效有效的预过滤信号（IEEE ICTAI 2026）。
summary_cn: 只用应用名与包名的单类异常筛查 Name2Pkg：67k 应用上 AUC 0.982、模型 3.57MiB、CPU 推理 28ms，适合恶意软件大规模预过滤。
objective_summary: 提出以名称-包名一致性为信号的单类筛查方法，在 67k 真实应用上量化检测与成本指标。
evidence_note: 67,129 应用、留出测试、FPR 固定下报告召回、部署成本量化；数据时效与家族分布未细说，会议级别一般。
novelty_note: 信号本身（名称与包名不一致）简单而新颖，方法为标准 seq2seq 异常检测。
scope: 结论适用于 Google Play 类命名规范下的 Android 应用筛查；对侧载渠道命名习惯不同的生态不外推。
limitations: 可被刻意模仿命名规避；单信号召回上限明显；地域语言对名称-包名关系的影响未分析。

title: Dissecting Agentic Forensics: The Role of Triage, Prompting, and Evidence Arbitration in Open-World Fake Image Detection
abstract: Image forensics is increasingly an open-world problem: manipulations range from fully synthetic images to localized edits, splicing and swapping, while most forensic detectors remain specialized to a single manipulation family. Agentic AI has recently emerged as a promising solution. In principle, such systems can assess the reliability of individual detectors, identify out-of-scope evidence, and arbitrate conflicting reports. However, it remains unclear which components actually drive performance and whether their benefits persist under distribution shift. To answer these questions, we study a training-free agentic framework built around specialist detectors, per-detector triage, and conflict-aware evidence arbitration. Using six configurations and three multimodal large language model backbones, we dissect the role of triage, prompting, and reasoning quality on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data. Our results show that naive detector fusion suffers from severe false-positive rates on authentic images. Triage and prompting consistently improve performance by filtering unreliable evidence and exposing detector limitations. However, the dominant factor is represented by reasoning itself: A stronger judge substantially outperforms a weaker one, particularly under distribution shift. Most notably, manipulation recall is nearly saturated across all configurations, indicating that the main challenge of open-world image forensics is not detecting manipulations, but calibrating trust in specialized forensic tools and arbitrating conflicting evidence.

title_cn: 解剖智能体取证：分诊、提示与证据仲裁在开放世界假图检测中的作用
abstract_cn: 图像取证日益成为开放世界问题：操纵范围从全合成图像到局部编辑、拼接与换脸，而多数取证检测器仍专精单一操纵族。智能体 AI 近来成为有希望的方案：原则上可评估单个检测器的可靠性、识别超范围证据并仲裁冲突报告。但哪些组件真正驱动性能、其收益在分布偏移下是否持续，仍不清楚。我们研究一个围绕专家检测器、逐检测器分诊与冲突感知证据仲裁构建的免训练智能体框架，用六种配置与三个多模态 LLM 骨干，在分布内与分布外数据上解剖分诊、提示与推理质量的作用。结果显示：朴素的检测器融合在真实图像上误报严重；分诊与提示通过过滤不可靠证据、暴露检测器局限而持续改善性能；主导因素是推理本身——更强裁判显著优于更弱者，分布偏移下尤甚。最值得注意的是：操纵召回在所有配置下都近乎饱和，说明开放世界图像取证的主要挑战不是检测操纵，而是校准对专业取证工具的信任并仲裁冲突证据（ECCV 2026 workshop）。
summary_cn: 解剖免训练取证智能体的组件贡献：分诊与提示有益、裁判推理质量主导；操纵召回近饱和，真正难点是证据仲裁与信任校准（ECCV 2026 WS）。
objective_summary: 以组件化消融解剖取证智能体框架中分诊、提示与裁判推理的贡献，指出开放世界取证瓶颈在仲裁而非检测。
evidence_note: 六配置 × 三骨干、分布内外对照、workshop 录用；数据集规模与统计检验信息有限。
novelty_note: 「检测饱和、仲裁是瓶颈」的结论对下一代取证系统设计有明确指向性。
scope: 结论适用于所选检测器族与 MLLM 裁判的图像取证设置。
limitations: 检测器池有限；裁判能力与通用模型演进强耦合；无统计显著性报告。

title: rApp/xApp Attestation: A New Security Use Case for O-RAN
abstract: The disaggregation and softwarization introduced by the Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) architecture enable multi-vendor innovation but also expose the RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) ecosystem to new runtime security risks. Existing O-RAN specifications define strong safeguards for onboarding, authentication, identity management, and secure communication; however, they do not provide a concrete mechanism for verifying whether deployed rApps and xApps remain in their intended, untampered state during operation. This paper introduces rApp/xApp attestation as a RIC-native O-RAN security use case for runtime integrity verification. Rather than proposing a new cryptographic protocol, the work defines how existing integrity verification techniques can be integrated into O-RAN through attestation modules, attestation agents, RIC application interfaces, and SMO-driven policy coordination. We map the use case to relevant O-RAN Alliance working groups, identify required standardization extensions, and demonstrate feasibility through a lightweight hash-based prototype implemented on the Near-RT RIC platform. Experimental results show attestation latencies below 40 ms across multiple cryptographic hash functions, indicating that runtime attestation can be performed without disrupting time-sensitive RIC operations when appropriately scheduled. Finally, we discuss remaining technical and standardization challenges, including trusted verification, known-good runtime states, scalability, mitigation policies, and future hybrid attestation mechanisms.

title_cn: rApp/xApp 证明：O-RAN 的一个新安全用例
abstract_cn: 开放无线接入网（O-RAN）架构引入的解耦与软实化促成多厂商创新，但也把 RIC 生态暴露给新的运行时安全风险。现有 O-RAN 规范为上架、认证、身份管理与安全通信定义了强保障，却没有提供验证已部署 rApp/xApp 在运行期间保持预期未篡改状态的具体机制。本文把 rApp/xApp 远程证明引入为 RIC 原生的 O-RAN 安全用例，用于运行时完整性验证：不提出新密码协议，而是定义如何把既有完整性验证技术经证明模块、证明代理、RIC 应用接口与 SMO 驱动的策略协调集成进 O-RAN。我们把该用例映射到 O-RAN 联盟相关工作组、识别所需标准化扩展，并在 Near-RT RIC 平台上以轻量哈希原型验证可行性：多种哈希函数下证明延迟低于 40 毫秒，表明运行时证明经适当调度可不干扰时间敏感的 RIC 操作。最后讨论剩余技术与标准化挑战：可信验证方、已知良好运行态、可扩展性、缓解策略与未来混合证明机制。
summary_cn: 把运行时远程证明定义为 O-RAN RIC 的新安全用例：映射标准化缺口并在 Near-RT RIC 上以哈希原型验证 <40ms 延迟的可行性。
objective_summary: 提出 O-RAN rApp/xApp 运行时证明用例与集成方案，给出原型延迟测量与标准化路线图。
evidence_note: 有真实 RIC 平台原型与延迟测量；但攻击场景检测效果与规模化未评估，测量维度单一。
novelty_note: 复用既有证明技术定义新用例，新意在 O-RAN 架构集成与标准化映射而非技术本身。
scope: 结论适用于 O-RAN RIC 生态与容器化 xApp 部署形态。
limitations: 可信验证方假设未解决；已知良好态管理、可扩展性与缓解策略停留在讨论。

title: New lower bounds for CDS and $f$-routing
abstract: Understanding the entanglement cost of non-local quantum computation (NLQC) is relevant to complexity theory, cryptography, quantum gravity, and related areas. A central special case is $f$-routing, motivated in part by quantum position verification. Proving lower bounds on its entanglement cost in the fully robust setting has been a major open problem in NLQC. Motivated by this problem, we establish two related lower bounds. First, we study the shared-randomness cost of robust conditional disclosure of secrets (CDS). The connection between CDS and $f$-routing established by Allerstorfer et al. (Quantum 2024) makes understanding the randomness complexity of robust CDS a natural step toward lower bounds for the fully robust routing problem. We show that the shared-randomness cost of robust CDS is lower bounded by the logarithm of deterministic SMP communication complexity, even when communication and private randomness are unrestricted. Our lower bound is tight for the equality function. Second, we consider one-sided-perfect $f$-routing, in which the protocol is exact on one input class and has constant error on the other. By exploiting the positivity of the low-rank matrix arising in the method of Asadi, Culf, and May (ITCS 2025), we derive a general lower bound on the entanglement cost in terms of sign rank. In particular, this yields a linear lower bound on the entanglement cost of routing for the inner-product function in both one-sided-perfect settings, matching the known upper bound.

title_cn: CDS 与 f-路由的新下界
abstract_cn: 理解非局域量子计算（NLQC）的纠缠代价与复杂性理论、密码学、量子引力等领域相关。核心特例是 f-路由，其部分动机来自量子位置验证。在完全鲁棒设定下证明其纠缠代价下界是 NLQC 的主要公开问题。受此问题驱动，我们建立两个相关下界。其一，我们研究鲁棒条件秘密披露（CDS）的共享随机性代价：Allerstorfer 等（Quantum 2024）建立的 CDS 与 f-路由的联系，使理解鲁棒 CDS 的随机性复杂度成为通向完全鲁棒路由下界的自然一步。我们证明：即使通信与私有随机性不受限，鲁棒 CDS 的共享随机性代价也以确定性 SMP 通信复杂度的对数为下界；该界对相等函数是紧的。其二，我们考虑单侧完美 f-路由——协议在一类输入上精确、另一类上常数错误——利用 Asadi、Culf 与 May（ITCS 2025）方法中低秩矩阵的正性，导出以符号秩表达的纠缠代价一般下界；特别地，这给出内积函数路由在两个单侧完美设定下的线性纠缠下界，匹配已知上界。
summary_cn: 证明鲁棒条件秘密披露的共享随机性代价下界与单侧完美 f-路由的符号秩纠缠下界，后者对内积函数匹配已知上界（理论密码学/量子信息）。
objective_summary: 针对 NLQC/f-路由的纠缠代价给出两个新下界，其中内积情形达到紧。
evidence_note: 证明型工作：结果自洽、部分情形达到紧界；「证据强度」以证明完整性与匹配程度计。
novelty_note: 把鲁棒 CDS 随机性复杂度与 f-路由下界贯通并首次给出单侧完美设定的线性界，属实质理论推进。
scope: 结论限于所定义的鲁棒/单侧完美模型与所证函数类。
limitations: 完全鲁棒设定的主问题仍未解决；技术依赖特定矩阵正性条件。

title: Temporal Generalization and Explanation Stability of Control Flow Graph Neural Networks for Malware Detection
abstract: Malware detection is a critical task in cybersecurity, and graph neural networks over control flow graphs have shown promising results for it. However, detectors are usually evaluated on a random split of a corpus collected over a single period, which cannot show how well a model generalizes to later samples. This study addresses that limitation with a strict temporal split: every model is trained on one period and scored once on a later one. Two corpora of control flow graphs, each node carrying 37 features, were extracted statically from 1,989 Windows portable executables: 459 graphs from 2024-2025 for training and 223 from 2026 for evaluation. Twelve variants and a flat-feature control were trained on the earlier corpus. The choice of message-passing operator changes robustness to the shift significantly, and every pairwise gap that survives correction separates an aggregating architecture from one built around a learned attentional readout. The ranking also reverses: the flat control, which sees node features but no topology, is the best in-distribution model and among the worst across the boundary, so a conventional benchmark would have rejected message passing. Neither recalibration nor ensembling substitutes for the operator choice. Attributions do not shift, but explanation validity is architecture-specific, and the most accurate operator on the later corpus is the hardest to explain. An architecture derived from the finding matches the best searched operator without search. The shift affects both malware and benign classes alike, so these are results about robustness to distribution shift, not malware evolution.
